question: Israel military action against Yemen by October 31?
resolution_criteria: Yes if an Israeli air strike or surface-to-surface missile strike directly impacts Yemen by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM Arabia time. Intercepted munitions do not count. Resolves with Polymarket market israel-military-action-against-yemen-by-october-31.
